title: Abuse review
idea: Abuse review: Reports and minimal evidence support a permissioned moderation decision
audience: People who need to review abuse within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: Raw personal data is displayed by default
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its review abuse priority and explicit commitment contract: Restrictive actions are auditable and support authorized appeal
navigation: Abuse review keeps the current review abuse context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Reports and minimal evidence support a permissioned moderation decision
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review abuse; operators need justified limited-access decisions
composition.priority: Restrictive actions are auditable and support authorized appeal

imagery.role: Support the actual review abuse context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Focus allegation evidence and action scope at narrow widths
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the abuse review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review abuse content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Restrictive actions are auditable and support authorized appeal
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review abuse content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Restrictive actions are auditable and support authorized appeal
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review abuse context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
